version.description: Version is the version of the License format.

uid.description: UID is the unique identifier of the License.

organization.description: Organization is the organization that the License was issued to.

issuedAt.description: IssuedAt is the date at which the License was issued.

notBefore.description: NotBefore is the date starting from which the License is valid.

notAfter.description: NotAfter is the expiry date of the License.

type.title: Type
type.description: Type is the type of the License.

allowedClusterDomains.description: AllowedClusterDomains is the list of the Cluster domains that the License is valid for. An empty list means that the License is valid for every Cluster domain.

License.title: License
License.description: License is the commercial License that entitles the Cluster to use the enterprise features. It is issued by Octelium Labs as a signed JWT which is supplied to the Cluster via the SetLicense method. The fields below are the verified claims of that JWT.

uid.description: UID is the unique identifier of the organization.

displayName.description: DisplayName is the human-readable name of the organization.
